1981-2415-3845-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2023-4289-4770-6965.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1707-7839.description:
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Last Laugh triggers, dealing 1 damage to each player and creature.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.
1707-7839.notes: You can use any self-sacrificing artifact, such as Food or Clue tokens, in place of the Treasure to start. Depending on the token used, you may need additional mana or other pre-requisites.

1619-2438-4605-5542-6145.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6145.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Passageway Seer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Passageway Seer enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Passageway Seer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Passageway Seer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Passageway Seer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Passageway Seer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6145.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1017-1494-7435-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Hardened Academic by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Wizard Class triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

997-1394-2060-7038-7704.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Doc Samson.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Doc Samson.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4184-5147-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
4184-5147-6972.notes: If Relentless Skaabs starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

372-5913-7431.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Daydream exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-5913-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Pinnacle Monk and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Pinnacle Monk trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Daydream.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Pinnacle Monk and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grub, Storied Matriarch // Grub, Notorious Auntie

2105-4885-7196.description:
Declare Grub and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks. Grub and Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Grub trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Combat Celebrant and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of it.
Combat Celebrant dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase, using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

500-1777-2719-3191.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and creating two token copies of it that are nonlegendary copies of Kairi.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing one of the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces tokens.
When the token dies, it triggers. Choose either mode.
Resolve Burnt Offering, adding {B}{B}{B/R}{B/R}{B/R}{B/R}
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger from step 5, causing you to mill six cards and return Saw in Half and Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat
500-1777-2719-3191.notes: You can forego casting Burnt Offering if you have enough black mana. This'll allow you to net creature tokens. The additional Kairi trigger in step 4 can be used to put all instants and sorceries from your library and graveyard into your hand, or to bounce permanents.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

206-1563-3899-4772.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

4017-4659-4772-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4017-4659-4772-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

851-1409-1449.description:
Activate Plundering Barbarian by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Barbarian enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Plundering Barbarian.
Resolve the Plundering Barbarian trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2734-3000-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-4716-5231-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4716-5231-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

261-3054-3416-5670.easyPrerequisites: You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
261-3054-3416-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire and Oathsworn Vampire enter, Suture Priest triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader twice by paying 2 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire and the Vampire token, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

972-2792-3277.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
972-2792-3277.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is an artifact.
When the Great Whale token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Izzet Chronarch by paying its mana cost.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch and the Great Whale token.
When the Izzet Chronarch and Great Whale tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
972-2792-3277.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Great Whale and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Izzet Chronarch instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with an indestructible counter on it

121-5619-6527.easyPrerequisites: You have three or less opponents.
121-5619-6527.description:
Activate Myojin of Roaring Blades by removing an indestructible counter from it.
Holding priority, cast Sway of the Stars by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand, graveyard and all permanents they own into their library, then causing each player to draw seven cards and set their life total to 7.
Resolve the Myojin of Roaring Blades ability, dealing 7 damage to each of up to three opponents.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

2423-4702.easyPrerequisites: Splinter Twin attached to Bounding Krasis.
2423-4702.description:
Activate Bounding Krasis by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the token Bounding Krasis enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the nontoken Bounding Krasis.
Repeat.

1495-2060-2292-5544-6431.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
1495-2060-2292-5544-6431.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Triskelion ability from step 3.
Repeat.

2556-3603-5195.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Mnemonic Wall
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Mnemonic Wall
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloudshift to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1170-2792-6057.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{W}{W}.
1170-2792-6057.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}{W}.
Cast Cage of Hands by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Great Whale.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cage of Hands spell.
Activate Cage of Hands by paying {1}{W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2084-2897.notablePrerequisites: Gigantoplasm is a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
2084-2897.description: Activate Gigantoplasm by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Gigantoplasm into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

2757-3519-5696.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2757-3519-5696.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic land.
2757-3519-5696.description:
Cast Jyoti from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Jyoti enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad creature token for each time you've cast Jyoti from the command zone this game.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Jyoti, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat steps 3 and 4 for each Forest Dryad token created in step 2.
Activate Food Chain by exiling Jyoti, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to return Jyoti from exile to the command zone.
Activate Food Chain by exiling a Forest Dryad token, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Repeat step 8 for each remaining Forest Dryad token.
Repeat from step 1.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego exiling or tapping the Forest Dryads.

849-1020-2146-3689-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {R}.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it and Anax trigger.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Resolve the Workshop Assistant trigger, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {1}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {R}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it and Anax trigger.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Resolve the Myr Retriever trigger, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Satyr, adding {R}.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {2}.
Repeat.

1770-3456-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Rapacious Dragon.
Rapacious Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1479-3703-3756.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3703-3756.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Sporemound, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Sporemound trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
